title: Scoped grants and reliable revocation
scope: Implement central policy shared by lists, detail, report use, and commands.
Apply bounded grant diffs with membership access_version and idempotency receipts.
Use transaction locks and append-only audit privileges; expire staff membership at decision time.
excluded: Authorization cache in the first release
invariants: Resource use requires active membership, project, entitlement, resource, and explicit grant.
Resource row locks precede organization locks and membership locks.
Use and revoke linearize through shared/exclusive organization transaction locks.
Every target organization has at least one active non-expiring customer access manager; staff never satisfy continuity.

acceptance.given: A manager has no grant for an entitled resource
acceptance.when: the manager lists consumer resources or creates a report
acceptance.then: that resource is excluded and use is denied despite the management role

acceptance.given: A staff member has grants in A and B
acceptance.when: a grant in A is removed
acceptance.then: B remains accessible only through B membership; A is denied

acceptance.given: Staff expiry passes while waiting for a lock
acceptance.when: a decision executes after acquiring locks
acceptance.then: the decision is denied using the clock after waiting

acceptance.given: A client submits the same key and fingerprint twice
acceptance.when: the grant command commits and is retried
acceptance.then: the stored result is returned and one grant transition/audit exists
acceptance.evidence: idempotency replay and audit count tests

acceptance.given: Another editor commits a membership version first
acceptance.when: a new command uses the stale If-Match value

acceptance.given: Audit insertion fails during a grant mutation
acceptance.then: the grants, membership version, receipt, and audit all roll back
a pre-revoke use may complete; every decision after revoke commit denies

acceptance.given: Only one durable customer manager remains, even if expiring staff managers exist
acceptance.when: the command locks the organization and counts valid managers
acceptance.then: 409 last_manager_required; concurrent suspension cannot remove both durable managers

acceptance.given: A user supplies a different organization ID on each data path
acceptance.when: lists, detail, audit, reports, and grants execute
acceptance.then: no metadata, counts, cursor, or records leak across organizations

acceptance.given: An entitlement has grants and a mixed-plan pending invitation
acceptance.when: platform disables it with a reviewed current preview
acceptance.then: all exact-pair grants and the entire invitation are revoked, each changed membership advances once and unrelated pairs remain unchanged

acceptance.given: An operator reviewed an impact preview
acceptance.when: a new invitation or grant commits before the command
acceptance.then: 412 impact_changed with no mutations; reenable never resurrects revoked grants

acceptance.given: A disable affects more than a configured fanout cap
acceptance.when: the operator submits a valid command
acceptance.then: 409 entitlement_impact_too_large with no changes, audit mutation or receipt
